issues.detail: Hebrew 'כְּלֵי הָאַגָּנֹת' means 'bowls/cups' (vessels of basins), not 'đồ đựng bằng bạc' (silver vessels). The word 'אַגָּן' is a bowl or basin, not silver. Similarly, 'כְּלֵי הַנְּבָלִים' means 'jars/pitchers' (vessels of earthenware or jugs), not 'đồ đựng bằng đồng' (copper/bronze vessels). The Vietnamese translation incorrectly specifies materials (silver and copper) that are not in the Hebrew text, changing the meaning of the vessels described.
